title: Using AI to Simplify Complex Documentation and Design Tasks
summary: A developer describes using Microsoft 365 Copilot with Notebooks to parse supplier requirements documents and map them to Business Central AL development tasks, including header and line field definitions, improving efficiency in understanding complex API and file export formats.
key_points: Copilot can summarize complex supplier documentation and help map it to Business Central data structures
Using Notebooks enables collaborative discovery and documentation work that spans multiple days
Researcher mode allows Copilot to reference other created documents and search the web for validation
Critical review of AI outputs is essential; combining human expertise with AI suggestions improves accuracy
Copilot helps overcome analysis paralysis by generating initial documentation drafts

quotes.text: The big value here is the use of Notebooks to compartmentalize the discovery and documentation process.
quotes.why_it_matters: Notebooks enable organized, collaborative, and persistent documentation work on complex requirements over time

quotes.text: if the human and the AI don't agree, it is something that should be researched and validated.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical human review is necessary to ensure AI-generated documentation is accurate before using it in development

quotes.text: Having an assistant to ask questions, summarize data, and validate assumptions is a great asset.
quotes.why_it_matters: Copilot provides continuous support for understanding requirements and generating documentation, regardless of developer experience level
